pr_title: [NativeAot] Null ref return is wrapped in TargetInvocationException
pr_body: When a null ref return method is invoked. Fixes #69755

issue_context.title: In NativeAOT, Null ref return throws NullReferenceException but should be wrapped in a TargetInvocationException
issue_context.body:
In `System.Reflection.Tests.InvokeRefReturnNetCoreTests`, the tests `TestNullRefReturnInvoke<T>` and `TestNullRefReturnOfPointer` expect a `System.Reflection.TargetInvocationException`, but in NativeAOT it throws a `NullReferenceException`.

Related to https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/67457 and https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/69336.
